tenderSchedule.title: Supply of 15 Nos of Electrofusion Machines Including Training to 15 Gram Panchayaths of Yellapur Taluk in Uttara Kannada District under EAP
tenderSchedule.description: Supply, installation, testing and commissioning of portable Electro fusion Welding Machine suitable for HDPE/MDPE pipe jointing works for village water supply distribution systems, with welding range of 20 mm to 200 mm, compatible for electro fusion couplers, reducers, elbows, tees and saddles, operating on single phase 220-240V AC, 50 Hz power supply having barcode scanning and manual data entry modes, automatic welding cycle control, digital LCD/LED display indicating welding parameters and error status, minimum 2,000 joint data memory storage, input cable length of minimum 3.5 metres and output cable length of minimum 3.5 metres, complete with barcode scanner, heavy duty welding cables, connectors, carrying case, user manual and basic tool kit, with inbuilt safety protections such as overload, short circuit, reverse polarity and voltage fluctuation protection, suitable for outdoor field conditions along with minimum 12 months warranty, operator training to gram panchayat water personnel, installation and demonstration at site, confirming to relevant BIS/ISI and ISO standards including transportation, loading, unloading

ALL OTHER CONDITIONS AS PER KG TENDER DOCUMENT

GST Quoting of Rates The tenderers are instructed to quote their rates exclusive of Goods and Services Tax GST Although the KPPP portal may display the heading Net Amount Inclusive of all applicable taxe the bidders shall enter/quote only the basic price, excluding GST. The bidders shall not include GST in the basic unit rates quoted in the financial bid. The financial evaluation shall be carried out uniformly on the basis of basic rates excluding GST.
